name: Totoro anatomy explorer
workflow: User-approved Blender MCP anatomy implementation; existing exterior proportions are the fixed reference.

referenceSuitability.reason: Exterior geometry is observable; the user explicitly requests imagined human-inspired internal anatomy.

geometryStrategy: Closed lofted tissue surfaces, cortical shells, modeled organ cavities, branched tubular volumes, authored cortical gyri. Blender Z-up converted to glTF Y-up.
materials: Two Image Gen albedo sources, independent baked normal and roughness channels, stable PBR system colors.
interaction: One plane with stencil caps, authored explosion offsets, shared metadata for filtering and picking.

reviewHistory.reason: First curved tubes used an unstable moving frame. Corrected parallel transport; added rounded epiphyses and costal cartilage. The proportion review shows a broad skull and thorax, low pelvis, short limbs, matching the existing shape.
reviewHistory.remaining: Final multi-angle and exported-volume checks follow with the complete assembly.

reviewHistory.reason: Replaced primitive brain folds, balloon-like lungs and oval stomach with sculpted cortical grooves, tapered lobes, a four-chamber myocardial volume and a hollow J-shaped stomach.
Aligned hand anatomy with the source paws and recessed superficial tissues beneath the exterior envelope.
Used proportional skin inset and disabled even-thickness amplification at narrow ear tips; final skin envelope is smooth and contained.
Preserved single primitive materials so intact organ surfaces render alongside stencil caps; retained intended camera direction through layout resize.
Placed the panel after the viewer on mobile, eliminated horizontal overflow, and made selected names visible above the viewer.

Named coverage, manifold volumes, texture decoding, metadata, transfer and triangle budgets, interactive cuts, exploded selection, desktop/mobile controls and production checks pass. The anatomy is an imagined study with simplified major structures.
